Trade FX rates are entered per transaction and remain unchanged. TWD profit uses moving-average cost, including purchase costs and deducting sale costs. Unrealized profit includes currency movements and excludes future selling costs. Opening balances are not cash outflows. Same-day entries follow trade time and entry order. Data is stored in this browser by default. If you enable Google Drive backup, backups are sent to the Google account you authorize. Export a standard or encrypted backup in Settings.

薪資紀錄由本機處理，未設薪資自動上傳、帳號或廣告分析功能。網站主機可能處理 IP、連線時間與技術日誌，實際項目依主機服務政策；這與薪資內容分開。Android 本機資料庫未啟用資料庫層加密，裝置鎖定與 App 解鎖不等於資料加密。一般備份、JSON／CSV 匯出不加密；僅明確選擇密碼加密的備份提供加密保護，SHA-256 只用於完整性核對。主動分享／另存至第三方服務時，檔案由所選服務處理。可在資料管理匯出、刪除本機紀錄；外部備份須自行刪除。|Payroll records are processed locally, without automatic payroll uploads, accounts or advertising analytics. The hosting provider may process IP addresses, connection times and technical logs under its policies, separately from payroll data. The Android local database is not encrypted at the database level; device and app locks are not data encryption. Standard backups and JSON/CSV exports are unencrypted. Only explicitly password-encrypted backups provide encryption; SHA-256 checks integrity only. Files shared or saved to third-party services are handled by those services. Export or delete local records in Data management; delete external backups separately.

本機資料可在資料管理匯出與清除。清除瀏覽器資料或解除安裝可能使本機資料遺失。一般備份可被取得檔案的人讀取；請妥善保管。|Export or clear local data in Data management. Clearing browser data or uninstalling may erase local records. Anyone with a standard backup file can read it; store it securely.
